<h1 class="hero-name">Minjin Kim</h1>


<div class="hero-bio">

I am an Assistant Professor of [Second Language Studies](https://sls.msu.edu/), [TESOL](https://lilac.msu.edu/tesol/), and [Korean](https://lilac.msu.edu/korean/) in the [Department of Linguistics, Languages, and Cultures](https://lilac.msu.edu/) at Michigan State University. I hold the title of <span class="kf-title">Korea Foundation Assistant Professor</span>. I serve as Director of the Korean Program and Co-Director of the [Second Language Studies Corpus Lab](https://corpus.cal.msu.edu/). I earned my Ph.D. in Applied Linguistics from Pennsylvania State University.

My research focuses on corpus linguistics, second language acquisition, and language learning and technology, with a particular interest in generative AI. More broadly, I examine how second language learners use language and how their language develops over time, and I explore how computational methods and AI-assisted technologies can support language learning, teaching, research, and assessment, as well as how AI can be used critically and in research-informed ways in language education.

</div>
